@@ -23,6 +23,7 @@ export const config = {
     { id: "low-latency",    label: "Low-Latency"    },
     { id: "balanced",       label: "Balanced"       },
     { id: "high-throughput", label: "High-Throughput" },
+    { id: "agentic",        label: "Agentic (MTP + HiCache)" },
   ],
   nodesOptions: [
     { id: "single",  label: "Single Node" },
@@ -189,6 +190,16 @@ sgl-eval run aime25 \\
                   "--speculative-eagle-topk 1", "--speculative-num-draft-tokens 2"],
           disable: { hw: ["mi355x", "mi325x", "mi300x"] },
           disableReason: "MTP/EAGLE speculative decoding is not yet validated on AMD ROCm (MI300X/MI325X/MI355X): the gfx950 spec-decode draft kernel is not yet validated and at --speculative-num-steps > 3 hits a separate build issue; the DSA nextn draft path is CUDA-only." },
+        { id: "mtp-415", label: "EAGLE / MTP 4-1-5 (agentic · B300 FP8)",
+          flags: ["--speculative-algorithm EAGLE", "--speculative-num-steps 4",
+                  "--speculative-eagle-topk 1", "--speculative-num-draft-tokens 5"],
+          enable: { hw: ["b300"], quant: ["fp8"] },
+          enableReason: "InferenceX AgentX B300 FP8 depth for concurrency 4 and 16." },
+        { id: "mtp-617", label: "EAGLE / MTP 6-1-7 (agentic · B300 FP8)",
+          flags: ["--speculative-algorithm EAGLE", "--speculative-num-steps 6",
+                  "--speculative-eagle-topk 1", "--speculative-num-draft-tokens 7"],
+          enable: { hw: ["b300"], quant: ["fp8"] },
+          enableReason: "InferenceX AgentX B300 FP8 depth for concurrency 1." },
         { id: "mtp-314", label: "EAGLE / MTP 3-1-4 (agentic · MI355X MXFP4)",
           flags: ["--speculative-algorithm EAGLE", "--speculative-num-steps 3",
                   "--speculative-eagle-topk 1", "--speculative-num-draft-tokens 4"],
@@ -485,6 +496,44 @@ sgl-eval run aime25 \\
       ],
     },
 
+    // B300 + FP8 agentic (InferenceX AgentX): TP8 EAGLE/MTP with a 270 GB/rank HiCache
+    // host-DRAM pool. Per concurrency: c1 6-1-7 --max-running-requests 2; c4 4-1-5 mrr 3;
+    // c12 5-1-6 mrr 5; c16 4-1-5 mrr 7 plus --prefill-decode-interval 8 and write_through.
+    // Pick the depth in the Speculative Decoding card; cuda-graph-max-bs is 2x concurrency.
+    {
+      match: { hw: "b300", variant: "default", quant: "fp8", strategy: "agentic", nodes: "single" },
+      verified: false,
+      env: [],
+      flags: [
+        "--trust-remote-code",
+        "--model-path {{MODEL_NAME}}",
+        "--tp 8",
+        "--quantization fp8",
+        "--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3",
+        "--bf16-gemm-backend cutedsl",
+        "--tool-call-parser glm47",
+        "--reasoning-parser glm45",
+        "--speculative-algorithm EAGLE",
+        "--speculative-num-steps 5",
+        "--speculative-eagle-topk 1",
+        "--speculative-num-draft-tokens 6",
+        "--max-prefill-tokens 8192",
+        "--chunked-prefill-size 8192",
+        "--mem-fraction-static 0.85",
+        "--max-running-requests 5",
+        "--cuda-graph-max-bs 24",
+        "--enable-hierarchical-cache",
+        "--hicache-size 270",
+        "--hicache-write-policy write_back",
+        "--hicache-io-backend direct",
+        "--hicache-mem-layout page_first_direct",
+        "--watchdog-timeout 1800",
+        "--enable-metrics",
+        "--host {{HOST_IP}}",
+        "--port {{PORT}}",
+      ],
+    },
+
     // ====================================================================
     // B300 + BF16 (Blackwell Ultra, 8-GPU single node) — TP8. Verified on 8xB300 (v0.5.13.post1).
     // The unquantized GLM-5.2 (~700B, ~1.51 TB) only fits single-node on 8xB300
